sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The instant application for regular bail has been filed by the petitioner in connection with Jankinagar P.S. Case no. 76 of 2021 instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 366A, 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of POCSO Act, which was earlier rejected by this Court vide order dated 8.8.2023 in Cr. Misc. No. 26608 of 2023 with a direction to trial court to expedite and conclude the trial.
4. In compliance of order dated 13.3.2024, a progress report dated 22.03.2024 has been received which suggests that trial is likely to be concluded within four months.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that trial has not been concluded as yet.
He further submits that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19073 of 2024(3) dt.15-05-2024 petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 3.2.2022.
6. Considering the fact that there is no new ground to reconsider the bail application of the petitioner.
Hence, this application stands disposed off.
